court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court, Cuddalore, H.M.O.P. No. 53 of 2021
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2016 and lived together abroad. Matrimonial discord arose and the respondent-husband instituted a divorce petition. The petitioner-wife seeks to transfer the case from the Family Court, Cuddalore to the Sub Court, Sankari, Salem District.

legal_principles.principle: In transfer of matrimonial proceedings, Courts have accorded primacy to the convenience of the wife, unless the husband demonstrates grave prejudice.
legal_principles.held: Courts have consistently accorded primacy to the convenience of the wife, unless the husband demonstrates grave prejudice.

legal_principles.principle: Compelling a party to contest a divorce petition at a far-off place would, in effect, make meaningful participation in the proceedings difficult and thereby compromise their right to a fair hearing.
legal_principles.held: Compelling her to contest a divorce petition at a far-off place would, in effect, make meaningful participation in the proceedings difficult and thereby compromise her right to a fair hearing.

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the transfer of the case from the Family Court, Cuddalore to the Sub Court, Sankari, Salem District.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure
advising on divorce proceedings in Family Court
assisting with withdrawal and transfer of cases between courts
